title: Taiwan Strait tensions tracker
description: Taiwan Strait tensions: PLA drills, grey-zone moves, US arms sales, key actors, a sourced timeline, what to watch, and monthly conflict events and fatalities.
overview: This tracker reports the latest available monthly humanitarian conflict summary for Taiwan. It is a country-level pulse, not a comprehensive incident ledger, a measure of the Chinese military pressure recorded in Taiwan's daily aircraft and ship counts, or a forecast.
